Would anyone out there be interested in creating and contributing their own Doom/Doom II maps for a Voat community choice map pack, if I (or someone more qualified) were to organize a little competition? I guess I should first ask, would anyone even be interested in playing Doom maps created by the Voat community? I know I would.

My idea was to create a post calling for people to contribute maps for the competition. People could submit their maps by uploading them somewhere, and then sharing them in the comments. People could then download them, play them, and vote on which are the best. Those would then be compiled into a WAD, and shared in the post. My goal would be a WAD of 32 maps (like the original full games), if possibleâ€”I have my doubts. I figure it could be a yearly competition (or more frequent, if there is more participation).

I also thought it would be awesome if there was anyone that wanted to create/contribute their music for the maps as well. Maybe there are people out there that can make textures/sprites too? I don't know. Just some ideas. I figure the more community involvement the merrier.

The best part is that mapping for Doom is actually relatively simple, with modern tools. Almost anyone could do it, given a few tutorials. There are plenty of written tutorials that can show you the basics, and/or videos, for those that don't care to read. I figured I could just collect up a bunch of links to the best learning resources, and provide them, for people that want to learn and contribute.

The tools/other stuff that people would require to take part (or at least my suggestions):

  • Doom II, or more specifically the Doom II WAD, for textures, etc. If you have a copy of the game (can be bought for fairly cheap on Steam and GOG), you have it.
    • Alternatively, there is also Freedoom, but the sprites/textures are not quite as nice, in my opinion.
  • GZDoom, for playing/testing.
  • GZDoom Builder, for map making.
  • SLADE, for compiling the maps into a WAD.
  • Possibly the Brutal Doom mod, just because it adds more depth to the gameâ€”not to mention makes it a ton more fun.

I could handle the compilation, and would probably contribute a map as well, and maybe even some music, and/or a title screen.

I've been kicking this idea around for a whileâ€”actually originally had the idea for a Reddit community map pack, when I still used Redditâ€”but haven't really done anything with it until now. Again, these are all just ideas, and this post is just an attempt to gather input/more ideas.

And just for shits and giggles, here is a little title screen I threw together quickly, when I had the idea for a Reddit community map pack:

http://i.imgur.com/6RqBZN3.png

I know the background is boring, but I was focused on the letters. Letters are more my thing. The "Reddit" was drawn by myself, in about 20 mins, using a mouse. Now imagine the background was more interesting, and it says "Voat" instead of "Reddit".
Would anyone be interested in a Voat community choice map pack, for Doom/Doom II?

As for how easy it is to make maps with GZDoom Builder, here is part (the second part) of a video tutorial, showing you the absolute basics:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RgR4f4ulD0k

It might be a bit overwhelming at first, if you've never done anything like it before, but I know I got the hang of it fairly quickly (within a day). It's basically just drawing shapes on some grids to create rooms, adjusting room heights, adjusting light levels, and placing enemies/items. All of those things are pretty simple to do. That said, you can do a lot more than that, if you get into it, such as scripting, which will give you more control over switches/triggers/traps/enemies, and let you do some interesting things.
